WITH src AS (
 SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
)
SELECT count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_line_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dist_rcpt_line,
 count(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS receipts, min(sale_date), max(sale_date),
 min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at), count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS n_loads,
 sum(CASE WHEN channel_code='WB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wb_lines,
 sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS staff_lines,
 sum(CASE WHEN net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos_net,
 sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos_qty

WITH src AS (
 SELECT f.*, s.store_id, s.format, p.category FROM fact_sales_line f
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
), r AS (
 SELECT receipt_id, count(DISTINCT store_id) n_st, count(DISTINCT staff_purchase_flag) n_staff, count(DISTINCT sale_date) n_dates,
   bool_or(category='ZZ Test') has_test, bool_and(category='ZZ Test') all_test, min(store_id) st, min(format) fmt
 FROM src GROUP BY receipt_id)
SELECT 'multi_store' k, count(*) FROM r WHERE n_st>1
UNION ALL SELECT 'mixed_staff', count(*) FROM r WHERE n_staff>1
UNION ALL SELECT 'multi_date', count(*) FROM r WHERE n_dates>1
UNION ALL SELECT 'has_test', count(*) FROM r WHERE has_test
UNION ALL SELECT 'all_test', count(*) FROM r WHERE all_test
UNION ALL SELECT 'store900', count(*) FROM r WHERE st=900
UNION ALL SELECT 'store999', count(*) FROM r WHERE st=999
UNION ALL SELECT 'fmt_'||fmt, count(*) FROM r GROUP BY fmt

calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period
)
SELECT s.format,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE s.store_id < 900
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
  AND d.fiscal_period = params.fiscal_period
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH mine AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, f.sale_date AS d, sum(f.net_amount) net, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) rc
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
 GROUP BY 1,2), c AS (
 SELECT store_id, business_date d, net_sales_before_returns net, receipts rc FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
 WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND store_id<900)
SELECT count(*) AS storedays, sum(CASE WHEN m.d IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) only_ctrl, sum(CASE WHEN c.d IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) only_mine,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(coalesce(m.net,0)-coalesce(c.net,0))>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) net_diff_days,
 sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(m.rc,0)<>coalesce(c.rc,0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) rc_diff_days,
 sum(m.net) mine_total, sum(c.net) ctrl_total, sum(m.rc) mine_rc, sum(c.rc) ctrl_rc
FROM mine m FULL OUTER JOIN c ON m.store_id=c.store_id AND m.d=c.d
